title: India's one-rupee note returned as a government issue in 1940
body: The Reserve Bank of India took over note issuance in 1935. When the one-rupee note returned as a wartime measure in 1940, the Government of India issued it directly.
takeaway: Two notes can serve as money in the same country even if they come from different issuing authorities.
source: Reserve Bank of India, Bank Notes: Retrospect on Indian Currency

title: Indonesia's real GDP fell about 13% in 1998
body: During the Asian financial crisis, Indonesia's production fell sharply. World Bank data put the 1998 contraction near 13% after adjusting for prices, so the figure describes a fall in output.
takeaway: In a crisis, a figure reported in currency can move very differently from the amount of goods and services produced.
source: World Bank, Indonesia: Avoiding the Trap
